_comment: Open purchase orders for the Step 2.2 two-way match. Copy to
purchase_orders.json and replace with an export from your ERP.
amount_invoiced is what earlier invoices have already consumed -- without
it, over-billing split across several invoices is invisible, since each
one can sit under the PO total while the sum does not.
status must be one of: open, approved, partially_invoiced,
partially_received. Anything else is treated as closed to invoicing.
